data.notes: June 2026 is anchored by Bali’s cultural PKB season plus a concentrated run of electronic music at Nuanu, Café del Mar, and Savaya.

events.title: LOCUS Bali 2026
events.summary: Four-day drum ’n’ bass festival at Nuanu Creative City with a lineup including Goddard, Pola & Bryson, Spor, Concord Dawn, DJ Craze, London Elektricity, Danny Byrd, Calyx, TC, Doc Scott and LSB.

events.title: Pesta Kesenian Bali (PKB) 2026
events.venueName: Denpasar City / Taman Werdhi Budaya Art Centre
events.summary: Bali’s major annual arts festival presents Balinese performing arts, parade formats, exhibitions, workshops and cultural programs across Denpasar. The official Indonesia.travel listing confirms the June 13–July 11 dates and free admission.

events.title: Eric Prydz at Savaya Bali
events.summary: Eric Prydz headlines Savaya’s cliffside stage on Saturday, June 20, with doors listed for 3:00 PM on the venue’s official event page.

events.title: ARTBAT at Savaya Bali
events.summary: ARTBAT play Savaya Bali on Sunday, June 21, with the venue listing doors from 1:00 PM and positioning the duo as the main act.

events.title: Pure Music Festival 2026
events.summary: A beachfront house and techno festival at Café del Mar Bali, headlined by Konstantin Sibold, Rafael Cerato and Young Franco, with Tristan K and Atlantys also listed.

events.title: Jonas Blue at Savaya Bali
events.summary: UK DJ and producer Jonas Blue headlines Savaya Bali on Friday, June 19, with the official venue page listing a 3:00 PM doors time.

events.title: Will Sparks at Savaya Bali
events.summary: Australian electronic artist Will Sparks plays Savaya Bali on Friday, June 26, with doors listed at 3:00 PM on Savaya’s official calendar.

events.title: Giolì & Assia at Savaya Bali
events.summary: Italian duo Giolì & Assia headline a Sunday event at Savaya Bali on June 14, with the venue listing doors from 1:00 PM.

events.title: Fideles at Savaya Bali
events.summary: Italian duo Fideles headline Savaya Bali on Saturday, June 6, with Savaya’s official page listing the event date and 3:00 PM doors.

events.title: Alec Monopoly at Savaya Bali
events.summary: Alec Monopoly is listed as the headliner for Savaya Bali on Saturday, June 13, with the official event page confirming 3:00 PM doors.
